// List relevant events 30 minutes before and after selected LogonAttempted event
let selectedEventTimestamp = datetime(2020-06-04T01:29:09.2496688Z);
search in (DeviceFileEvents, DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceEvents,
DeviceRegistryEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceImageLoadEvents,
DeviceLogonEvents)
Timestamp between ((selectedEventTimestamp - 30m) .. (selectedEventTimestamp +
30m))
and DeviceId == "079ecf9c5798d249128817619606c1c47369eb3e"
With some knowledge of the query language, you can adjust the query to your preference. For
example, you can adjust this line, which determines the size of the time window:
Kusto
In addition to modifying the query to get more relevant results, you can also:
View the results as charts
Create a custom detection rule
Advanced hunting overview
Learn the query language
Work with query results
Custom detection rules
| sort by Timestamp desc
| extend Relevance = iff(Timestamp == selectedEventTimestamp, "Selected event",
iff(Timestamp < selectedEventTimestamp, "Earlier event", "Later event"))
| project-reorder Relevance
